calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

geometry_spec.anchor_direction: strictly before and strictly after target within same input block
geometry_spec.derivatives: native timestamps, centered interior and one-sided block endpoints; unknown coordinates stay NaN

spec.hypothesis: Genuinely new all-player control/interception geometry, reliable native-observation contact anchors, and ordered before/after support improve FULL H/A/D spell recovery; 127leaves separately tests additional capacity on identical full features.
spec.scope: Three-class objective and full H/A/D probability vectors; standalone trees plus fixed50/50 complete-vector GRU blends. No conditional-team preservation or D-only replacement.
spec.training: Exact clean/coarse-ball joint-GRU base records;25% same frozen whole-core ball-gap replacement, direct+H/A-swapped records. Build nonlinear/temporal features separately on coherent original and alternate views before replacing cores. Equal provider/match/view total mass. All learned components exclude evaluation provider.
spec.sampling: Training-only: split at input discontinuities and contiguous known H/A/D label runs; retain first/last3 samples of each run at5Hz, interiors stride4 (1.25Hz). Integer within-run nearest-selected Voronoi weights preserve original5Hz class/time mass. Unknown labels have zero mass. Every tiny run remains represented.
spec.symmetry: Swap raw204+geometry+anchor channels BEFORE nonlinear temporal engineering; labels0/1 exchange, D2 unchanged. Predict direct+swapped, mapH/A back and average. Explicit even/odd/pair manifest verifies transformations.
spec.budget: 12fits (4arms x3providerfolds);640multiclass boosting rounds per fit,3class trees per round (up to1920trees). This is a bounded initial budget, not mathematically equivalent to1280binary rounds or a convergence claim. Record full training multi_logloss progression; no early stopping or outcome-driven extra fits.
spec.evaluation: 300new cells:4configs x15match/views x5recipes (standalone plus bothcontrol/dropoutGRUseeds). Reuse60GRUrows. Freeze all12tree checkpoints and all12GRUcheckpoints before new scoring; seal every native sharedview/probability hash.
spec.primary: Unrounded equal-provider clean official spellF1; macroF1 exact-tie. Average matches within provider, stress replicates within match, then equal providers. Fixed .7spell+.3macro auxiliary only; report GRU seeds separately, no seed-selected checkpoint.
spec.guardrails: Versus adopted-recipe matched full-provider archived baseline: clean spell >= baseline+.01; worst-provider clean D-F1/macro loss <=.02; stress spell >= baseline-.01. Report paired blend-vs-corresponding-GRU changes. Every recipe is assessed independently; no automatic promotion.
spec.limitations: Five historically exposed external development matches, including silver labels and SkillCorner visibility/X censoring; synthetic stress is not independent broadcast confirmation. Full multiclass trees can use ball-source shortcuts; D is NOT player-only. Tree seed variance and1280-round fullHDA budgets are unmeasured.
spec.diagnostics: Exact per-IoU spell counts, short/edge recall, overlapping fragmentation/merge geometry, complete-boundary timing; Dprecision/recall; training-gain families and training-loss progression are descriptive, not held-out causal importance.
spec.supersedes_scope: D-only temporal_lgbm_v1 and capacity_lgbm_v1 retained with scope-correction receipts; no scores opened in them
